items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Walker, now I heard his music, man.

ctx.x: Yeah. And you mentioned George Walker, also.

George Walker, now I heard his music, man. That’s a black composer. They sure should have had him, because he really was in another world. He’s in another world, and um, I wish I had a chance to meet him. Is he still living?
I believe he is, because I used to see him at Rutgers, when I was at Rutgers, he was there. I’m thinking of another composer, how about Ulysses Kay?
